newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates slip to 22.375 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates slip to 22.375 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates dropped on Thursday about half as much as they rose in a surprise surge on Wednesday, and the slippage was seen continuing, traders said.
"Government bonds maturing on Friday will free up tens of billions of forints," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Overnight rates dropped to a 22.375 percent close compared with quotes of between 23 and 23.50 percent in early trade and Wednesday's close of 23 percent.
Traders said returning liquidity would probably bring down overnight rates in the region of the central bank's one week reverse repo facility, standing at 21 percent.
